name: Targeted Bidding Opportunity Notices to MBE / WBE / DBE / SDVO / CBE Firms
description: Efforts to notify qualified diverse and local businesses of bidding opportunities, e.g. website postings, automatic alerts and bid packages online.
recipient: Minority-, women-, disadvantaged-, veteran-owned and Cheltenham-based businesses
quote: The District shall make efforts to notify potentially responsible and qualified MBEs, WBEs, DBEs, SDVOs, and CBEs of District bidding opportunities.
